[{"insert":"Sumo Deadlift

The sumo deadlift uses a wide stance with your feet turned out and hands gripping inside your knees. This shortens the pull and puts more work on your hips and inner thighs than a regular stance. Drive your feet out into the floor as the bar leaves the ground and keep your chest tall. Reps drop every other week so you can add weight each time sumo comes back.
"}]
